title: Wrangler x Stranger Things 13MWZ Jean (35W x 34L), Wrangler Blue

comparisons.notes: Wrangler x Stranger Things 13MWZ Cowboy Cut Jean, Wrangler Blue, style #112376179, sold and shipped by Walmart.com; in stock (confirmed for size 31x32 on the same style page).

writeup: Woot has the Wrangler x Stranger Things 13MWZ cowboy cut jean in Wrangler Blue, size 35x34, new for $15.99. Walmart sells the same style (#112376179) for $42.17, so this is about 62% less. It's 100% cotton with Hawkins-print pocket lining, and Woot's page showed only 1 left.
